top_violation_types.title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One out of four employees was missing the hazardous materials training.

top_violation_types.title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A sampling of children records were evaluated. One child's immunization record was observed incomplete.

top_violation_types.title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device (26 TAC §746.2426(a)(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: An infant was observed sleeping in a restrictive device.

top_violation_types.title: Protective Barriers Around Porches or Platforms (26 TAC §746.4601(9))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A play structure being used by infants and toddler had a platform 29 inches off the floor and did not have a barrior that would prevent a child from falling off the platform. During the inspection, an infant age child almost fell off the platform through the opening.

top_violation_types.title: Infant Care Area - Safe, Open Floor Space (26 TAC §746.2403(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: There is sufficient evidence to show that a soft play structure was positioned too close to the unpadded floor and not more on the carpeted area.

top_violation_types.title: Diaper Changing Steps- Prompt (26 TAC §746.3501(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Information obtained throughout the investigation shows that caregivers did not promptly change a child's soiled diaper, resulting in a rash.

top_violation_types.title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Keep Records for 3 Months (26 TAC §746.4751(d))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: There are 3 areas in the combined playground area that have exposed nails and sharp edges on the border that holds the wood chips for ensuring soft play surfaces.

top_violation_types.title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two infants did not have current infant feeding schedules.
